Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a computer and appends the .saturn extension to the file's name

Deletes shadow volume copies, disables Windows startup repair, and clears the Windows backup catalog using commands: cmd.exe /C vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet & wmic.exe shadowcopy delete & bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures & bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no & wbadmin delete catalog -quiet
Drops ransom notes (#DECRYPT_MY_FILES#.html, #DECRYPT_MY_FILES#.txt), a key file (#KEY-[id].KEY), a speech script (#DECRYPT_MY_FILES#.vbs), and changes desktop background (#DECRYPT_MY_FILES.BMP)
Uses a TOR payment site (su34pwhpcafeiztt.onion) for ransom payment
Checks for virtual machine environment and exits if detected
Attack Vector: Unknown distribution methods; possibly via infected files or remote access
Indicators of Compromise: File extension .saturn appended to encrypted files
